title: LLM-generated multistep programming projects
summary: Junior undergraduates review or undertake multistep programming projects containing a description, learning stages, sample code, and tests. A multi-agent LLM workflow generates and iteratively critiques the project materials; students compared generated projects with instructor-made variants in an A/B study.

sources.title: A High-Quality Generation Approach for Educational Programming Projects Using LLM
sources.evidence_quote: We conduct an A/B test with 60 junior undergraduate students to compare the man-made projects versus the LLM-generated ones.

assessment.summary: Work through or evaluate a staged educational programming project generated by an LLM workflow.
student_actions: Engage with project descriptions, learning steps, sample code, and tests.
Rate the generated and instructor-made project variants.

student_role.description: The LLM generates project materials before students receive them.

assessment_system_role: Generate and iteratively refine multistep programming projects.
